findings.summary: The route segment validation policy is duplicated instead of reusing the shared utility.
findings.consequence: Callers already use both app/lib/internal-navigation.ts and shared/utils/route-segment.ts for the same route-segment policy, so future changes can silently diverge between author/internal navigation and library/dramawebben/server validation.
findings.evidence: app/lib/internal-navigation.ts:34-45 implements the same checks as shared/utils/route-segment.ts:3-14. Direct inspection found app/lib/author-works.ts imports validRouteSegment from internal-navigation while app/lib/library/view-model.ts, app/pages/dramawebben/pjäser.vue, and server/utils/legacy-dramawebben-route.ts import the shared version.
findings.recommendation: Delete the local implementation and re-export or import the shared function from #shared/utils/route-segment so all route segment validation uses one policy source.
